data.long_description:
Lime Gardens is the latest residential tower development by Emaar Properties. The beautiful and astounding views of the place make it more relevant and unique from other residential developments. You are getting an excellent opportunity to experience the fresh luscious morning with an iconic view of Burj Khalifa and the Dubai skyline.

It is situated in a well-connected region of Dubai. For home buyers, it can be the perfect address because they can find all the desired destinations within a short distance. The greenery of the place surrounds you with its gloriousness and offers natural serenity to enjoy your life by staying connected with nature too. Greenery should be a part of every living being, and everyone needs that amazing kind of freshness and coolness around them.

Open spaces and world-class recreational amenities make the place more attractive and enjoyable. Your modern home is an ideal place that is connected with nature too. You can lead your life comfortably and calmly within a well-balanced community. The elegantly crafted interiors are so attractive that everyone would surely love this kind of luxury within their apartment.
